decisions.question: SPEC 0291 (approval bound to the conversation): today an approval granted in one conversation can execute in another conversation of the same tenant, including on the production kernel worker path (harmless today because effects are synthetic; P1 before any real effect). Proposal: record the origin (conversation, plus session when present) with the approval and deny with origin_mismatch before reserving. Recommended: AO-A conversation always plus session when present; AO-B legacy approvals without origin execute with an audit event and a removal deadline; AO-C do not bind the operator yet (the worker's operator comes from the message body); AO-D PostgreSQL column now; AO-E new code origin_mismatch. Approve as recommended?

decisions.question: SPEC 0292 (PAR-S02, session projections with cache): today reading 1 event of a session validates the whole log (about 85 µs per event, 1.7 s at 20,000 events). Proposal: pure projections (state, stops, compaction) plus an opt-in checkpoint cache, so a read only checks the checkpoint and reads the tail. Recommended: SP-A only what log v1 supports (goals and todos later); SP-B stop = fact in the log, with no claim of resolution; SP-C only the writer saves the checkpoint, on the append that crosses K, plus flush/close; SP-D service only, no SDK yet; SP-E no message text in the cache; SP-F table in the same schema with the same RLS; SP-G project is not an integrity proof. Approve as recommended?

decisions.question: SPEC 0293 (PAR-C03, spill of large tool outputs): today a 115 KB output reaches the model as 300 characters with no cut warning, and the full content is lost. Proposal: outputs above 8 KiB go to a dedicated store; the model gets a framed preview of 2 KiB + 1 KiB and a locator, and reads the rest with a governed spill.read tool. Recommended: D1 SpillStore port with PostgreSQL (nothing outside tests before it); D2 8 KiB / 3 KiB preview / 8 MiB / 32 KiB per read; D3 a failed write is never silent (stored=no); D4 24 h retention, 7-day ceiling, purge; D5 spill.read counted in the budget; D6 prune applied once, stable; D7 raw content bound to tenant and session under RLS; D8 quota of 256 objects per session and 256 MiB per tenant. Approve as recommended?
